notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting' (8): My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Watto's Box, Start Your Engines!, Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site and Coruscant: Galactic Senate; these count toward the 60.
The title calls it a 'Type II' deck and the strategy a 'Closed Environment' deck (Episode I-only environment). The Coruscant-set Dark printings are used for Sense, Alter and Control.

The starting section uses joke names: 'My, Lord Is That Legal?/If it is, I'll plead Insanity.' dested the Objective; 'Daytona 500' dested the Dark Boonta Eve Podrace and 'Tatooine RacePlace' the Dark Tatooine: Podrace Arena (both deployed by Start Your Engines!); 'TAtooine Maul's Hutt' dested Tatooine: Desert Landing Site and 'Senator Death Chamber' the Dark Coruscant: Galactic Senate (the Objective's two starting locations).
The strategy says Begin Landing Your Troops or The Phantom Menace is sometimes started instead of Watto's Box.

Posted 'Lotti Doddi, We Like To parti.' dested Lott Dod; 'Yeb Yeb Whatever' Yeb Yeb Adem'thorn; 'Aurra Sung' Aurra Sing; 'Pa$$el Argente' Passel Argente; 'Mauls Stick' Maul's Lightsaber; 'No, Civility No Politics' No Civility, Only Politics; 'Squabling Delegates' Squabbling Delegates; 'Start You Engines' Start Your Engines!; 'Drop' Drop!.
Wipe Them Out, All Of Them is the Coruscant Effect, not the Reflections III Defensive Shield (posted before Reflections III).
